title: Linear equations
goal: I can solve linear equations, including equations with fractions.
teach: Keep the equation balanced: whatever you do to one side, do to the other. Remove brackets, and clear fractions by multiplying every term by the lowest common denominator (LCD). Collect the x-terms on one side and the numbers on the other. Check by substituting your answer.

ex.q: Solve x+43 − x−25 = 2.

watch:
When you multiply by the LCD, multiply the right-hand side too.

Problem-solving lens
Check every answer by substituting it into the original equation.

qs.steps:
1. Rule (linear equation): do the same to both sides. Expand brackets, collect the x-terms on one side and the numbers on the other, then divide by the coefficient of x.
2. Expand: 3x − 6 = 2x + 10
3. Subtract 2x: x − 6 = 10
4. Add 6: x = 16

qs.text: x−12 = x+34
qs.steps:
1. Rule (fractions in an equation): multiply every term on both sides by the LCD (lowest common denominator) to remove the fractions.
2. LCD = 4: 4 × x − 12 = 4 × x + 34
3. 2(x − 1) = x + 3
4. 2x − 2 = x + 3, so x = 5
